rules.exempt_reason: An accepted 600-bond diagram needs 600 distinct atom pairs, which the generators cannot express. Case bonds-600-pass-count-checks pins by its message that exactly 600 bonds pass this check and stop at the duplicate-bond check.
As for sketch-bond-count: the accepted side needs hundreds of distinct bonds. Case ligand-bond-total-600-passes pins by its message that a total of exactly 600 passes this check.

cases.name: precedence-composition-before-sketch-exclusivity
cases.message: Use 1–3 columns and a figure width between 100 and 1800 pt

cases.name: precedence-sketch-exclusivity-before-sketch-validate
cases.message: Use either a diagram or SMILES molecules/reactions, not both

cases.name: precedence-sketch-validate-before-size
cases.message: Use a diagram with 1–300 atoms, at most 600 bonds and 100 shapes

cases.name: precedence-size-before-molecules
cases.message: The proposal is too large; request a smaller drawing

cases.name: precedence-molecules-before-reactions
cases.message: Use at most 32 molecules with short labels and valid SMILES

cases.name: precedence-reactions-before-branching
cases.message: Each reaction needs reactants, products, short conditions and a supported arrow

cases.name: precedence-branching-last
cases.message: A branching scheme needs at least two reactions sharing the same single central reactant (identical SMILES, coefficient and compact setting). Put reagents in conditions.
